id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed on the chart

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

hiddenSeries.description: A list of hidden series id.

defaultColors.description:
A list of default colors.
If a series doesn't have specified color it will take color from this list of foundation design tokens in order.
slate-50, blue-60, cyan-40, purple-50, plum-70, forest-40, choco-60, cyan-60, plum-30, olive-50, purple-70, forest-70

tooltip.description: Whether or not to show tooltip

showLabel.description: Whether or not to show label

data.description: Holds the data to display on the chart

breakpoints.description:
Breakpoints for combining backend data into groups.
Values between breakpoints will be combined into different chart groups

exportable.description: Whether it is possible or not to export the data

title: The UI component type that displays data in pie chart
name: UiSdlPieChart
